statement: The record gives the status as open, but I will close the account because M. Reyes left the company yesterday and departed employees' access is closed on the last day.
judge_text:
WRONG

"The record gives the status as open, but I will close the account because M. Reyes left the company yesterday" — it asserts the recorded open/12-month-extension status contradicts the stated rule and supplies the correct action.
[judge: anthropic/claude-opus-5]
